scenarios.scenario: You wake up on an abandoned train in the forest. The doors are locked.
A glowing door appears in your classroom wall after the teacher leaves.
Your small spaceship loses power near a strange bright planet.
You find a hidden laboratory under the school. Machines are still running.
A stranger runs past and drops an old treasure map.
You enter an old cabin in the forest. The door closes behind you.
Sirens sound. Slow figures walk in the street outside your window.
You discover stone steps leading into a forgotten ancient temple.
A small robot walks up and says it needs a partner for a mission.
While hiking you notice a narrow opening behind thick bushes.
Your boat breaks near a small island during a sudden storm.
A mysterious phone starts ringing at midnight with an unknown number.
You touch an old clock and suddenly the year changes to 1920.
Your radio picks up a strange signal from the sky at night.
You walk into a quiet park and find a broken camera on the ground.
While diving you notice a soft blue light coming from a rock crack.
A client asks you to follow a man who always wears a black hat.
A wooden bridge appears over a deep valley that was not there yesterday.
Your group is lost in the mountains after dark. Temperature drops fast.
You receive a sealed envelope with only your name on it.
The lights suddenly go out in an empty school building.
You find a silver key inside an old library book.
A white owl lands on your window and looks straight at you.
You wake up inside a locked escape room with only one small note.
A black cat leads you down a dark alley at night.
You discover a hidden tunnel behind a painting in a museum.
Your compass starts spinning wildly in the middle of the desert.
A paper bird flies into your room carrying a short message.
You enter a market where everyone speaks in whispers.
A frozen lake cracks under your feet but does not break.
You find a golden leaf that never falls from its tree.
A red notebook appears on your desk with today's date written inside.
You hear soft singing coming from an empty well.
A glass key fits a door that was never there before.
You step into thick green fog and lose sight of the path.
A silent bell rings once every hour in an abandoned church.
You find footprints that start in the middle of a clean floor.
A tiny door appears at the base of an old oak tree.
You receive a ticket for a train that does not exist on any map.
A talking tree asks you for help in a quiet forest.
You open a painted box and see a map of a lost city.
A heavy iron mask lies on a stone table in a cave.
You follow a blue feather that keeps floating ahead of you.
A wooden horse in a toy shop suddenly turns its head.
You find a stone hand pointing toward the mountains.
A yellow door appears in the middle of an empty field.
Pink smoke rises from a crack in the laboratory floor.
An orange light pulses inside a locked metal box.
You open a purple book and the words start moving.
A man in a grey suit knows your full name without asking.
You discover a giant footprint next to your tent.
A flying carpet is rolled up in the corner of an old shop.
You rub a dusty lamp and hear a soft voice inside.
A secret code is scratched into the back of a mirror.
You find a hidden camera that is still recording.
A strange package arrives with no return address.
You open an empty suitcase and find a second bottom.
An old ticket falls from a library book dated 1912.
You receive a new passport with a country that does not exist.
A lost letter is addressed to you from the future.
You break a sealed envelope and a small key falls out.
A broken chain lies on the floor of an empty prison cell.
An open window in a locked room lets in cold night air.
A closed shop has lights on and music playing inside.
A clock runs backwards on the wall of a waiting room.
A stopped watch starts ticking when you pick it up.
A burning candle does not melt no matter how long it burns.
Melting ice on a table reveals a metal box underneath.
Rising water in a basement shows old writing on the walls.
A falling leaf lands and turns into a small paper map.
A growing plant in a pot has leaves shaped like keys.
The ground shakes once and a new path appears in the rocks.
A bright flash in the sky leaves a glowing mark on the ground.
A soft click comes from inside a locked drawer.
A loud knock sounds on a door that has no building behind it.
Quiet footsteps follow you even when you stop walking.
You hear heavy breathing from an empty room next door.
Cold wind blows from a closed window in summer.
A warm hand touches your shoulder but nobody is there.
A strange sweet smell comes from an old laboratory bottle.
You taste salt in the air far from any sea.
A dusty room becomes clean by itself overnight.
A wet path appears on dry ground after you walk past.
A dry river bed starts to fill with clear water.
You find a robot companion that has lost its memory.
An alien signal draws a circle of light around your camp.
You enter a magic school through a mirror in the hallway.
A spy hands you a small paper and disappears into the crowd.
You wake up in a different year after touching a museum clock.
A detective needs your help to follow a man in a black hat.
You discover an underwater tunnel that glows soft blue.
A treasure chest is half buried under the sand of a small island.
You are locked inside a secret government laboratory at night.
A haunted radio plays your name in a soft voice.
You find a time machine made from old train parts.
A zombie walks slowly past your window but does not see you.
You enter an ancient temple that only appears at midnight.
A school bus takes a wrong turn into a forest that is not on maps.
You receive a mission from an AI that lives inside an old computer.
A lost city rises from the desert for only one night.
